claims.assertion: Mari says ghosts and apparitions exist; some are deceased people’s astral bodies, while others may be hostile entities or egregors.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says sustained, emotionally charged thoughts can manifest as material things or events, individually or collectively.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says one person may suffice.

claims.assertion: Mari says deceased souls may retain astral bodies and interact with the living through strong attachments, but ultimately return to Source.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says some remain in lower astral realms temporarily.

coverage_gaps: time as a perceptual separation between realms
